'''Verein für Leibesübungen Bochum 1848 Fußballgemeinschaft''', commonly referred to as '''VfL Bochum''' ({{IPA|de|faʊ̯ʔɛfˌʔɛl ˈboːxʊm|-|De-VfL Bochum.ogg}}), is a [[Football in Germany|German professional association football club]] based in the city of [[Bochum]], [[North Rhine-Westphalia]]. They currently play in the [[2. Bundesliga]] following relegation from the [[Bundesliga]] in the [[2024–25 Bundesliga|previous season]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=place |first=Bochum and Holstein Kiel were relegated from the Bundesliga after defeats by Mainz and Freiburg respectively, but Heidenheim still has a chance of escaping the relegation play-off |title=Bochum, Kiel relegated as Heidenheim gets lifeline |url=https://www.beinsports.com/en-nz/football/bundesliga/articles-video/bochum-kiel-relegated-as-heidenheim-gets-lifeline-2025-05-10 |access-date=13 May 2025 |website=beIN SPORTS |language=en-nz}}</ref>"}}
